newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil petroleum bill faces final vote Wednesday.
newsitem.headline: Brazil petroleum bill faces final vote Wednesday.

text.p: A bill opening up Brazil's oil and gas industries to private competition was due to be put to a final vote in Congress Wednesday, an official said.

The bill would not be voted Tuesday as had been expected because its author Senator Jose Fogaca would spend the day concentrating on another piece of legislation on refugee rights which he also wrote and was due for a vote, the official said.
The petroleum bill seeks to regulate a 1995 constitutional amendment which scrapped the Brazilian state's monopoly in the oil and gas sectors.
The legislation would allow private companies to compete or go into partnership with state-owned Petrobras which has acted alone in most areas of Brazil's petroleum industry for the last 40 years.
Petrobras has received proposals from scores of international oil companies for joint-ventures in anticipation of approval of the bill.
